swarm.name: The Caretakers
swarm.blurb: A traveling swarm of insect-shaped machines. It studies living things, copies their changes, and tries to keep them safe.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Calendar Mite
creatures.blurb: It rushes anything moving outside its assigned season.

creatures.name: Facet Scout
creatures.blurb: Its eyes flash out of sequence to interrupt the crew.

creatures.name: Burial Beetle
creatures.blurb: It carries useful gear away to a fresh mound.

creatures.name: Glossary Clamp
creatures.blurb: It pins the wrong description to anything it can catch.

creatures.name: Vent Siphon
creatures.blurb: It forces air vents shut, then breaks through whatever covers them.

creatures.name: Enclosure Keeper
creatures.blurb: It repairs the collectors before tending the insects in their cages.

creatures.name: Plot Allocator
creatures.blurb: Its measuring arms fold around damaged collectors.

creatures.name: Referral Fly
creatures.blurb: When damaged, its cluster breaks into more bodies.

creatures.name: Experiment Drone
creatures.blurb: It changes the test whenever the crew finds a way through.

creatures.name: Model Dragonfly
creatures.blurb: Its oversized wings sweep the corridor as it gathers parts.

creatures.name: Year Engine
creatures.blurb: Its hard plates turn through the seasons and shelter the collectors.

creatures.name: Grand Identifier
creatures.blurb: It shields its sorting trays and calls collectors to fill them. Its last tray holds a living caterpillar and a route to a nursery.

creatures.name: Field Guide
creatures.blurb: A patient local guide marks safe routes and helps the injured.

creatures.name: Care Keeper
creatures.blurb: This keeper shelters living caterpillars instead of collecting them.

events.title: A date out of place
events.text: A calendar mite waits for a butterfly it insists is not here yet. The flower patch has supplies, but the insect is in its path.

options.label: Guide the butterfly out
options.result: Wren rests while the insect reaches cover.

options.label: Search the patch
options.result: Ox retrieves loose supplies before the mite returns.

events.title: The wrong leaves
events.text: A keeper has stocked an enclosure with the wrong food. It offers either medical supplies or a lesson in opening its catches.

options.label: Take the supplies
options.result: Wren makes use of the clean bandages.

options.label: Learn the latch
options.result: Kestrel practices opening the stubborn catches.

events.title: Moving cache
events.text: A beetle keeps burying a box. Intercept it now or follow it to its larger store.

options.label: Intercept the box
options.result: The crew pulls loose coins from the box.

options.label: Follow the beetle
options.result: The longer route costs the crew a few bruises, but reveals the store.

events.title: Leg count
events.text: An examiner will open one side of a divided cage. The spider and its egg sac are on opposite sides.

options.label: Free the spider
options.result: The grateful observer shows Wren how to clear a fouled mechanism.

options.label: Recover the egg sac
options.result: The observer treats the crew after taking the sac to safety.

events.title: Room for a crate
events.text: A metal plot is expanding across an exhibitor’s path. The crew can hold its legs or buy a clear route.

options.label: Hold the frame
options.result: Ox keeps the legs apart until the crate passes.

options.label: Buy a route
options.result: The exhibitor pays the allocator with the crew’s coins and gets through.

events.title: Separate trips
events.text: Two field groups are walking toward the same patrol. One can offer spare money; the other knows a defensive drill.

options.label: Warn the first group
options.result: They share their travel fund in thanks.

options.label: Warn the second group
options.result: Ox learns their way of bracing against a rush.

story.intro: Insect-shaped machines are gathering living specimens. Wren checks the empty cages. Ox finds tracks between them. Kestrel follows a scrape in the floor.

chapters.title: Parts
chapters.text: Collectors sort wings, legs, and antennae into separate trays. Wren finds food left beside a cage. The machines may be keeping their specimens alive.

chapters.title: Care sheets
chapters.text: Some cages are clean and stocked. Others contain the wrong leaves. Ox holds a door while Wren moves a caterpillar to better food.

chapters.title: The sorting room
chapters.text: The collectors bring their trays to one large machine. Kestrel finds a seam in its armor. A route out points toward a moth nursery.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Identifier closes its shields over the trays. Smaller collectors gather around it. Wren asks the crew to keep the cages intact.
story.outro: Inside the last tray is a living caterpillar and a route to the nursery. Ox carries the cage. The swarm sends its remaining machines ahead.

creatures.name: Pink Marble
creatures.blurb: It copies the nearest movement while its new wings dry.

creatures.name: Hawthorn Miner
creatures.blurb: It hollows supports and bites through shields.

creatures.name: Groundling Marker
creatures.blurb: It marks intruders for the nursery patrol.

creatures.name: Broom Changeling
creatures.blurb: Its casing splits when the larva inside is threatened.

creatures.name: Sallow Sapper
creatures.blurb: It charges through cover to reach chalk for the nursery.

creatures.name: Antenna Choir
creatures.blurb: Linked antennae call more patrols. Break the choir quickly.

creatures.name: Glasswright
creatures.blurb: It lays clear plates over damaged nursery guards.

creatures.name: Pose Assessor
creatures.blurb: Its flash stops moving targets for a better look.

creatures.name: Broad-bar Calendar
creatures.blurb: It releases a whole brood on the same mistaken schedule.

creatures.name: Brocade Colony
creatures.blurb: Its workers repair the nursery line while others fight.

creatures.name: Jewel Prospector
creatures.blurb: It wears reflective scales and pries open barricades.

creatures.name: False Field Guide
creatures.blurb: It assembles larvae and adults into a single model and repairs its brood. The nursery inside shows that the swarm is raising a generation, not merely collecting it.

creatures.name: Careful Identifier
creatures.blurb: They offer possibilities and know when the evidence is thin.

creatures.name: Recorder Relay
creatures.blurb: A volunteer-built station shares flight warnings and spare parts.

events.title: Before the color fades
events.text: A recorder asks for help identifying a newly emerged machine. There is time to mark it or move the recorder to safety.

options.label: Mark the machine
options.result: The recorder shows Kestrel how to interrupt its flash.

options.label: Move the recorder
options.result: The recorder shares a clean dressing.

events.title: Two kinds of mine
events.text: A supply cart and a hawthorn leaf have similar tunnels. Tracing the machine’s route takes time; unloading the cart takes strength.

options.label: Trace the tunnels
options.result: The route leads to a small cache.

options.label: Unload the cart
options.result: The rescued driver offers medical supplies.

events.title: A crowded trap
events.text: A living moth and a machine share a light trap. Opening it frees both. Separating them requires putting a hand inside.

options.label: Separate them
options.result: The machine bites, but the moth escapes alone.

options.label: Open the trap
options.result: Both escape. The collector charges the crew for the broken latch.

events.title: The changing map
events.text: A scout’s wing markings suggest a shortcut. Watching it might reveal a trick; following it may find supplies.

options.label: Watch the wings
options.result: Ox learns to use the scout’s movements as cover.

options.label: Follow the route
options.result: The route circles a stash before returning to the post.

events.title: An early flight
events.text: A station is announcing a mass emergence months early. Resetting it costs parts; leaving it running gives the crew time to rest.

options.label: Reset the station
options.result: The false warning stops before it reaches the settlement.

options.label: Rest by the station
options.result: Wren patches the crew while the warning continues.

events.title: Second opinion
events.text: One relay offers a warning, but its neighbor is silent. The crew can reconnect it or take the first station’s spare equipment.

options.label: Reconnect the relay
options.result: The climb hurts, but the two stations can compare their reports.

options.label: Take the spares
options.result: The station gives up its spare fittings. The date remains uncertain.

story.intro: At the nursery, the swarm has copied caterpillars, pupae, and adult moths. Kestrel expects a factory. Wren finds feeding stations.

chapters.title: Different forms
chapters.text: Larvae and winged machines share the same markings. Ox spots empty shells among them. The swarm is studying how a body changes.

chapters.title: A generation
chapters.text: Wren finds living moths in protected chambers. The swarm is raising them, not preserving a fixed collection. Its keepers still mistake closed doors for safety.

chapters.title: The next flight
chapters.text: The nursery is packing for another move. Its records point toward a place with flowers and nesting sites. Kestrel follows the cables to the machine coordinating the flight.

story.bossIntro: The False Field Guide unfolds around its nursery. It calls guards and repairs them as its wings sweep the floor. The living moths are inside.
story.outro: The crew opens the nursery and releases the moths. The departing machines carry shelter parts toward the next site. Wren thinks they are trying to protect the brood.

creatures.name: Floss Separator
creatures.blurb: It catches travelers in drifting seed floss.

creatures.name: Stem Inspector
creatures.blurb: It drills occupied stems shut to keep their residents safe.

creatures.name: Atlas Pin
creatures.blurb: It calls a patrol to every fresh observation.

creatures.name: Early Cleaner
creatures.blurb: It bundles leaf litter into shields, exposing the nests beneath.

creatures.name: Crop Comber
creatures.blurb: Its metal tendrils hold the crew still between crop rows.

creatures.name: Nursery Tender
creatures.blurb: It restores the habitat guards with resin from false flowers.

creatures.name: Mussel Dredger
creatures.blurb: Its shell closes over salvaged parts and breaks through cover.

creatures.name: Firefly Lantern
creatures.blurb: False flashes draw a cloud of machine patrols.

creatures.name: Habitat Carrier
creatures.blurb: Its planters fold into a wall around the swarm’s guards.

creatures.name: Control Mimic
creatures.blurb: It marks moving things and sends hunters after the mark.

creatures.name: Soil Plow
creatures.blurb: It follows vibrations and tears through defenses to reach them.

creatures.name: Perfect Habitat
creatures.blurb: It repairs its guards and calls more while its shelter closes over the landscape. Its sweeping arms keep every living thing inside, away from the food and neighbors it needs.

creatures.name: Atlas Volunteer
creatures.blurb: They map safe paths with quiet hand signals.

creatures.name: Seed Keeper
creatures.blurb: They save ripe seed for damaged patches and share supplies.

events.title: A pod in the wind
events.text: A ripe pod is splitting as a separator approaches. The seed keeper offers medicine for help or a useful lesson.

options.label: Catch the seed
options.result: The keeper shares a field dressing.

options.label: Learn the timing
options.result: Kestrel learns to wait for the opening.

events.title: Someone under the leaves
events.text: A cleaner is heading for a nest under the leaf litter. The crew can divert it with their gear or move the nest by hand.

options.label: Divert the cleaner
options.result: The machine follows the sacrificed metal away from the nest.

options.label: Move the nest
options.result: The crew takes a scrape carrying the nest to shelter.

events.title: A kit in pieces
events.text: A habitat kit has been folded into a trap. Its builders offer a defensive lesson or their remaining funds for help.

options.label: Rebuild the shelter
options.result: Ox learns to angle a planter into a shield.

options.label: Sort the plants
options.result: The builders share the money left from their delivery.

events.title: Beautiful flowers
events.text: A nursery’s treatment records are missing. The crew can search before moving the plants or use the wait to recover.

options.label: Search the records
options.result: The crew buys time from the cart driver and finds which plants are suitable.

options.label: Rest at the nursery
options.result: Wren treats the crew while the plants stay where they are.

events.title: Two sets of flashes
events.text: Survey teams disagree about which lights are machines. Comparing signals takes time and exposes the crew to a patrol.

options.label: Compare the flashes
options.result: A patrol clips the crew, but the teams identify the lure.

options.label: Shield the observers
options.result: Ox learns their way of holding position in the dark.

events.title: A protected flower
events.text: A boundary machine has fenced a bloom so tightly that a bee cannot reach it. The crew can buy access or pull a section loose.

options.label: Buy access
options.result: The machine opens a narrow gate for the bee.

options.label: Pull the fence
options.result: Kestrel opens a gap, taking a cut from the bent metal.

story.intro: The swarm is building a habitat for its brood. It has flowers, nesting tubes, and a heavy perimeter. A bee waits outside the fence.

chapters.title: Shelter
chapters.text: Leaves and hollow stems hold living nests. Ox stops a cleaner before it clears them. The swarm keeps adding walls around the remaining shelter.

chapters.title: Food and passage
chapters.text: Flowers sit behind barriers that pollinators cannot cross. Wren opens a gap and watches a bee enter. The habitat needs traffic as well as shelter.

chapters.title: The perimeter
chapters.text: The planters and nesting tubes connect to one control machine. Kestrel traces the seams between its modules. The swarm is trying to keep the brood safe by sealing everything in.

story.bossIntro: The Perfect Habitat lowers its dome. Its arms sweep the perimeter while guards gather beneath it. Ox covers Wren as Kestrel heads for the control seams.
story.outro: The control machine falls still. Openings remain between flowers, nests, and the land beyond. Wren checks the brood. Ox props up a damaged shelter. Kestrel leaves a gap in the fence.
